description: Runs one change (POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE) of The Deployer's app as the person, with the same permission checks the app applies: domains, scaling, start/stop and schedules, databases and other cloud services, app access, build inputs, code review, hosting plans, retries, environments, blueprints, servers, adoption and more. Needs Operate access. Some changes cost money or change a live app. Secrets are never returned. Documented at https://portal.thedploy.com/docs.

body.description: The JSON body, for POST, PUT and PATCH

path.description: The operation's path with ids filled in, e.g. /projects/12/scaling

workspace.description: A teammate's workspace id. Default: your own.

name: api
title: Change something through an operation
